reason: The v3 global candidate-enumeration rule requires reviewing every later insurer and product even after the deterministic insurer-first ordering has identified the earliest eligible insurer. Later candidates cannot alter the selected outcome. This amendment replaces that non-selection-affecting exhaustive work with an outcome-equivalent deterministic stopping rule.

selection_rule_replacement.insurer_universe: Use the current IRDAI insurer list as the authoritative insurer universe.
selection_rule_replacement.insurer_order: Normalize insurer legal/display names to lower-case ASCII and screen them in ascending order.
prior_cold_start_exclusions: Star Health & Allied Insurance Co. Ltd.
Bajaj General Insurance Limited / Bajaj Allianz General Insurance Company Limited
HDFC ERGO General Insurance Company Limited
Tata AIG General Insurance Company Limited
Niva Bupa Health Insurance Co. Ltd.
selection_rule_replacement.insurer_screening_rule: For each insurer in order, use metadata only to determine whether at least one currently offered Indian retail Health indemnity product for individual and/or family-floater purchase has an official current policy wording, stable UIN/product identifier, and no governed product exposure at the frozen baseline.
selection_rule_replacement.stopping_rule: Stop insurer screening at the first insurer for which at least one product satisfies the insurer_screening_rule. Later insurers are not enumerated because they cannot change the deterministic selection outcome.
selection_rule_replacement.selected_insurer_product_enumeration: Enumerate every product from the first eligible insurer that can be verified to satisfy the v3 eligible-product rules using metadata only. Record eligible and excluded products for that insurer with reasons.
selection_rule_replacement.product_tie_break: Sort eligible products for the selected insurer by normalized UIN/product identifier ascending and select the first one.

unchanged_v3_rules: selection must occur after protocol and amendment merge
target-clause content must not be reviewed before the Product #6 selection record is committed
runtime and semantic/spec surfaces remain frozen during the initial attempt
target concepts remain copayment and waiting_period
all primary anti-gaming metrics remain applicable
Motor readiness remains gated on a new neutral repeatability proof
